name: The Office
description: A documentary crew captures the everyday absurdity of life at a mid-size paper company.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.premise: Michael Scott learns corporate is sending someone to downsize the Scranton branch and spends the day trying to prove his office is one big happy family while making everyone miserable.

episodes.title: The Dundies
episodes.premise: Michael hosts his annual awards ceremony at a Chili's, where Pam gets drunk enough to kiss Jim and the entire restaurant turns hostile.

episodes.title: Office Olympics
episodes.premise: While Michael and Dwight close on a condo, Jim organizes a full Olympic games using office supplies, awarding yogurt-lid medals in a surprisingly touching closing ceremony.

episodes.title: The Injury
episodes.premise: Michael burns his foot on a George Foreman grill and demands the office pamper him, while Dwight gets a concussion and becomes weirdly nice to everyone.

episodes.title: Boys and Girls
episodes.premise: Jan holds a women-in-the-workplace seminar while Michael takes the warehouse guys upstairs for a competing men's session that immediately goes off the rails.

episodes.title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
episodes.premise: Employees bring their kids to the office and a VHS tape of Michael's childhood appearance on a local TV show reveals his desperate need for attention started very young.

episodes.title: Michael's Birthday
episodes.premise: Michael demands attention for his birthday while Kevin waits for potentially devastating medical test results, and Jim struggles with whether to tell Michael.

episodes.title: Casino Night
episodes.premise: Michael invites two dates to the warehouse casino night, Dwight and Angela sneak away together, and Jim finally confesses his feelings to Pam in the parking lot.

episodes.title: Gay Witch Hunt
episodes.premise: Michael accidentally outs Oscar and then tries to prove he's not homophobic by kissing him in front of the entire office.

episodes.title: Diwali
episodes.premise: Michael misunderstands an invitation to Kelly's Diwali celebration and turns it into a disastrous proposal to Carol while wearing a paper-mache costume.

episodes.title: Business School
episodes.premise: Michael gives a rambling guest lecture at Ryan's business school while back at the office a bat terrorizes the staff and Dwight tries to kill it.

episodes.title: Beach Games
episodes.premise: Michael holds Survivor-style competitions at a lake beach to choose his replacement, and Pam finally walks across hot coals and tells the office how she really feels.

episodes.title: Dinner Party
episodes.premise: Michael and Jan host an excruciating couples dinner where their toxic relationship is on full display — Jan's candles fill every surface, the plasma TV is tiny, and Hunter's CD plays on repeat.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Toby
episodes.premise: Michael throws an ecstatic farewell party for his nemesis Toby, only for Holly Flax to arrive as the replacement HR rep and capture Michael's heart instantly.

episodes.title: Weight Loss
episodes.premise: The office enters a weight-loss competition against other branches, pushing everyone to extreme diets while Jim proposes to Pam at a gas station rest stop.

episodes.title: Stress Relief
episodes.premise: Dwight stages a fire drill that causes Stanley to have a heart attack, then Michael screens his own movie 'Threat Level Midnight' to boost morale.

episodes.title: Company Picnic
episodes.premise: Michael and Holly reunite to perform an HR-themed skit at the company picnic while Jim and Pam sneak off and discover they're expecting a baby.

episodes.title: Niagara
episodes.premise: Jim and Pam's wedding weekend at Niagara Falls becomes a spectacle as Michael gives an inappropriate rehearsal toast and the couple secretly marries on the Maid of the Mist.

episodes.title: Scott's Tots
episodes.premise: Michael must face a class of high schoolers he promised to pay through college ten years ago — with no money to give them — in the most painful scene ever filmed.

episodes.title: Threat Level Midnight
episodes.premise: Michael screens his completed action movie starring himself as Agent Michael Scarn, featuring the entire office in roles filmed over several years of production.

episodes.title: Garage Sale
episodes.premise: Michael proposes to Holly using a trail of treasured mementos from their relationship while the rest of the office haggles at a parking lot garage sale.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Michael
episodes.premise: Michael spends his final day at Dunder Mifflin saying goodbye to each person individually, giving away his possessions, and slipping away a day early so nobody has to watch him leave.

episodes.title: Finale
episodes.premise: The documentary airs and the entire office reunites for a panel discussion, where Dwight marries Angela, Michael returns with photos of his kids, and everyone reflects on what the cameras meant to them.
